title: 논리회로 진리표
summary: 안전한 불 대수식 파서, 6변수 진리표, 등가 SOP와 2~4변수 카르노 맵. 6개 언어 정적 경로.
features: Six-variable truth table and logical classification
Equivalent SOP using merged implicants and greedy coverage
Copy expression and UTF-8 CSV export
Fully localized UI, errors, examples, help and status

tests.name: Node syntax checks for core, app and catalogs
7 known truth fixtures and 8 invalid inputs
5 independent SOP equivalence fixtures, up to 64 rows
6 catalog key sets and generated language routes

limitations: Equivalent SOP is not guaranteed globally minimal; generated SOP may exceed input character limit
Browser visual and interaction QA not yet performed
